svg.title: Recover a backup on a fresh installation
svg.desc: Both local vault files must be absent. Inspection authenticates the external backup and exposes counts only. A new Master Password, newly saved Recovery Key and replacement sign-in Authenticator are confirmed. Core rereads the backup at commit, creates a fresh DEK and config, validates staged wrappers and ciphertext, then begins a new unlocked login after successful persistence.

g.text: Recover a backup on a fresh installation
Read arrows in order. SECRET = plaintext; KEY = encryption key; cylinders = stored data.
